name: Soul Date
source:
Your decisions will write every page of this story... before you, the sun and the moon illuminate vastly different paths that you cannot ignore, and each holds its own special way of loving.

Both paths lie before you, waiting for you to decide which one to follow...

Will you be able to win the heart of one of them?

[Translated from [url=https://c0rew.itch.io/souldate]itch.io[/url]]
